summary: Discrepancy: closed PO total differs from supplier invoice causing AP payment hold
description: Issue summary: Procurement closed PO #PO-2025-119 after goods receipt. Supplier invoice INV-8812 posted to accounting with a higher total than the PO final amount. Impact: payment is blocked by AP system validation and vendor is following up. Environment: NetSuite accounting instance (prod), Redwood procurement UI (prod). PO details: PO-2025-119, closed on 2026-01-07, original PO total $45,600, final receipts recorded $45,600. Invoice details: INV-8812 (Acme Devices), invoice date 2026-01-09, total $47,040 (includes a freight line that was not on PO). Expected behavior: invoice should match PO or route to three-way match exception workflow. Actual behavior: AP validation flagged mismatch and created a blocking hold; the system did not create an exception ticket and vendor payment is stuck. Steps to reproduce: 1) Open PO-2025-119 in procurement UI -> confirm closed status and receipts. 2) In NetSuite, open vendor credit/invoice INV-8812 -> see total $47,040 and line item for freight. 3) Observe AP validation rule 3-way-match strict equality triggers hold and no auto-exception created. Logs and references: NetSuite transaction: INV-8812, procurement audit log PO-2025-119 closure entry (procurement UI), vendor email thread linked below. Business impact: vendor escalation and potential late fee. Recommended next steps: confirm whether freight should have been added to PO as a change order, create a manual AP exception to release payment if approved, and add an automated fallback for freight/handling lines on closed POs (policy decision). Please coordinate with Procurement, AP, and Finance Tools for root cause and fix.
comments: 2026-01-11 09:18 - Evelyn Park: Created ticket after vendor (Acme Devices) emailed AP about overdue payment. PO was closed by receiving team; invoice has an extra freight line. Requesting AP to advise on releasing payment or issuing exception.

2026-01-11 11:04 - Marco Liu (AP): Acknowledged. Investigating whether freight should have been added as PO change. Placed a temporary manual hold to avoid accidental payment. Will validate with Procurement and Finance Ops.

2026-01-11 14:37 - Priya Mehta (Procurement): Receiving notes show delivered quantity matches PO. No change order exists for freight. Vendor billing terms indicate freight billed separately when shipped. We typically create a PO change for freight but this slipped through on this order.

2026-01-12 08:22 - Marco Liu (AP): Raised manual exception in NetSuite and queued for manager approval to release payment pending confirmation of freight responsibility. Ticket updated with invoice scan.

2026-01-13 10:10 - Alex Chen (Finance Tools): Noted that the three-way match engine enforces strict equality when PO status is closed; suggests adding rule to allow separate freight invoices up to X% or to auto-create an AP exception when a freight-only line is detected. Filed GH PR to add flag for freight exceptions: github.com/redwood/finance-tools/pull/442.

2026-01-13 12:05 - Marco Liu (AP): Payment released after manager approved manual exception. Vendor notified; finance to follow up on policy update. Closing tasks: confirm policy, update procurement checklist, implement code change for exception handling.
2026-01-13 12:10 - Evelyn Park: Confirmed vendor received payment confirmation. Will arrange a short retro with receiving team to avoid future omissions.
